scenes.audio: Elena holds an active Maryland life producer license. An insurer offers her a producer agreement.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: Static digital slide, teal header, off-white background. Functional box for license pops up. Flat lighting, corporate palette.

scenes.audio: The state license, business agreement, and insurer appointment are related but different. The license establishes authority.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Two additional boxes for agreement and appointment appear. Symmetrical layout. Clean transitions, high contrast, minimalist design.

scenes.audio: The insurer must itself be authorized for the business. A manager's email is no reason to ignore required documentation.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Static graphic remains. Focus on the relationship between documents. Consistent digital lighting and saturated teal accents.

scenes.audio: Maryland permits a licensed producer without an appointment to make an informal life insurance inquiry or solicit an application.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Slide change to flowchart. Dark teal header. Box one appears. Professional aesthetic, uniform margins, sharp text rendering.

scenes.audio: If an insurer initially accepts an application from an unappointed producer, it must act within thirty days.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Second flowchart box appears with connecting arrow. Simple animation. Same lighting and muted color scheme.

scenes.audio: Either reject the application or appoint the producer and enter the required information in its register.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Third flowchart box completes the sequence. Static framing on the full process. Depth is flat, focus is sharp across the frame.

scenes.audio: An insurer maintains its producer register and adds the required appointment information within thirty days.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: New slide with box layout. Insurer register box appears. Minimalist prop usage, digital environment, high-key lighting.

scenes.audio: The appointed producer keeps documentation. With written documentation, the producer may act before the register entry.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Written documentation box pops up next to first. Static camera, flat digital palette, no subject motion.

scenes.audio: Records stay available while the appointment is active and for five years after. Electronic records must be retrievable.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Electronic retrieval box appears. Complete three-box set. Balanced composition, corporate branding visible at top.

scenes.audio: A screenshot that cannot later be found is not a reliable record system.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Static view of previous graphic. Uniform digital lighting, no shadows, saturated accents on white background.

scenes.audio: An insurer updates its register within thirty days after termination. Certain terminations require notice to the commissioner.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Slide change to list format. First two points regarding register updates and copies appear. Consistent typography and spacing.

scenes.audio: Within fifteen days after notice, the insurer sends a copy to the producer, who has thirty days to submit comments.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Third point about producer comments appears. Static framing, clear focus, flat lighting palette.

scenes.audio: Ending one appointment does not mean the state has revoked the person's license. Those are separate decisions.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Final point on license discipline appears. Layout remains stable. Corporate color temperature remains neutral.

scenes.audio: The Maryland Insurance Commissioner enforces the insurance article and can conduct examinations and investigations.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: Slide change to triple column layout. Functional roles highlighted. High-key lighting, off-white background, teal accents.

scenes.audio: Grounds for discipline include misappropriating money, material falsehoods in applications, or forging insurance documents.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: Static frame on column detail. Clear legibility, digital rendering, flat shadowless environment.

scenes.audio: The statute provides notice and an opportunity for a hearing. A producer should not ignore a lawful order.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: Final graphic view of enforcement columns. Symmetrical design, neutral grading, sharp digital focus.

scenes.audio: The commissioner may impose a penalty from one hundred to five thousand dollars per violation. Restitution may be required.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: Final slide change. List of consequences and responses appears. Corporate aesthetic, static camera, flat lighting.

scenes.audio: If an independent producer suspects fraud, Maryland requires a written report. Do not conceal problems to protect sales.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: Points three and four appear. Clear list formatting. Saturated teal headers on white background.

scenes.audio: Preserve the facts, use the required reporting process, and cooperate within the law.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: Static shot of final slide points. Framing is centered. Design remains consistent with previous slides.
